question: What practice in solitude enables one to assume many forms through devoted meditation?
premises: The practice is to be done in solitude
One is instructed to assume many forms
One must be intent on meditation
inference: In solitude, being intent on meditation, one should practice assuming many forms
uncertainties: dhyānañ shows sandhi before ca in the given tokenization
plain_english: In solitude, intent on meditation, make yourself assume many forms.
